{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if recent history shows persistent downward drift and sentiment is negative.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias when true outcomes deviate significantly from historical mean over 10-15 days.",
    "Lower forecasts when sentiment history includes multiple negative signals (e.g., -0.25 or -1.00) over recent days.",
    "Increase downward bias for forecasts when true outcomes consistently underperform model predictions in early/medium horizon (e.g., 1-30 days).",
    "Avoid overreacting to single-day sentiment spikes; use rolling 5-day sentiment average to filter noise.",
    "If sentiment is positive but true outcomes are consistently below forecast, reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% to avoid overconfidence.",
    "For long-term (30-day) forecasts, apply a smoothing filter to reduce volatility and align with historical mean trend."
  ]
}
